title: South Korean Warning Signs.jpg
author: lamoix
source_description: Forget stickman - Korean warning signs have great illustrations of just what could go wrong.
modification: Displayed in a contextual viewport; source pixels are unchanged.
label: Check once more: illustrated safety reminders
description_en: Five cartoon construction-site panels show checking, electric shock, safe and unsafe behavior, removing hazards, and fire.
korean_text: 잠깐! 한번더 확인 / 감전주의 / 안전 · 불안전 / 위험요소는 내가먼저 제거 / 화기주의 · 불조심
translation_en: Stop a moment! Check once more / Beware of electric shock / Safe · Unsafe / I remove hazards first / Caution with fire · Beware of fire.
study_target: Learn 확인 (check), 위험요소 (hazard), 먼저 (first), and 제거 (removal), with illustrations supporting the meaning.
translation_scope: Main captions across the five panels; company logos excluded from translation. Spacing follows the signs.
quality_notes: Original object and visual context retained. Open the image and use Zoom for small lettering.
crop_presentation: One contextual rectangular view of the original photograph.

label: How to open the door in an emergency
study_target: Practice 열다 (open), 당기다 (pull), -면 (if), -을 수 있습니다 (can), and -지 마십시오 (do not).
quality_notes: Original object and visual context retained. Open the image and use Zoom for small lettering.
title: Doorwarning-seoulsubway.jpg
author: Nesnad at English Wikipedia
modification: Displayed in a contextual viewport; source pixels are unchanged.
description_en: An illustrated train-door panel shows opening a cover, pulling a handle, and sliding the doors apart.
korean_text: 비상시 문여는 방법 / 의자 양쪽밑의 뚜껑을 열고 / 손잡이를 화살표 방향으로 당기면 / 손으로 이 문을 열 수 있습니다. / 평상시에는 절대로 손대지 마십시오.
translation_en: How to open the door in an emergency / Open the covers underneath both ends of the seat / If you pull the handle in the direction of the arrow / You can open this door by hand / Under normal circumstances, never touch it.
translation_scope: Selected visible instructions, not every line. This is a photographed historical panel, not operating guidance for a current train.
crop_presentation: One contextual rectangular view of the original photograph.
